title: Bug 654031: Partner feedback: Mark "Custom Report Layouts" page caption with '(Obsoleted)' and also add a notification OnOpen
summary: Added obsolescence indication to the Custom Report Layouts page by marking its caption with '(Obsoleted)' and displaying a notification to encourage users to adopt the new Report Layouts system.
key_points: The Custom Report Layouts page caption now includes '(Obsoleted)'
A notification is shown when the page opens, pointing users to the newer Report Layouts system
The page has been outdated for two releases and this change nudges users to switch
The Report Layout Selection page has a related one-line change
quote: Custom Report Layouts has been outdated for 2 releases already.
